prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.395 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.1 s (3% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.40 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 403 W·min/l (5% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 54.8 % (6% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.6 bar (2% above healthy). Hydraulic accumulator effectively dampens load transients with normal pre-charge.
